moments.title: EFL Championship Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship season begins this Friday, with Wolves hosting Blackburn Rovers to open the campaign, followed by a weekend of matches across the league.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: Football's back! The EFL Championship kicks off this Friday, with Wolves vs Blackburn getting the 2026/27 season underway. Who are you backing for promotion this year?

angles.name: Welsh Teams Angle
angles.copy: Big weekend for Welsh football fans! The EFL Championship starts Friday, and our local teams like Wrexham and Swansea are gearing up for their opening fixtures. Get ready to cheer them on!

moments.title: The Weeknd Takes Over Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his record-breaking After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour to Wembley Stadium for a five-night residency starting this Friday, running through August 19.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: London, get ready! The Weeknd kicks off his massive five-night run at Wembley Stadium this Friday. Who's got tickets to the After Hours Til Dawn tour?

angles.name: London Specific
angles.copy: Wembley is about to light up! The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour starts its epic London residency this Friday. Five nights of hits ahead!

moments.title: Ariana Grande's O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's 'The Eternal Sunshine Tour' begins a highly anticipated ten-night residency at London's O2 Arena this Saturday, marking her first live performances in six years.

angles.name: Pop Event of the Summer
angles.copy: It's the pop event of the summer! Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at The O2 kicks off this Saturday. Who's been waiting for this?

angles.name: London Buzz
angles.copy: The O2 is about to get an 'Eternal Sunshine'! Ariana Grande starts her epic London residency this Saturday, running for ten nights. Get ready for some serious pop.

moments.title: Boomtown Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Boomtown, the immersive music and arts festival in Hampshire, is currently taking place until Sunday, August 16, featuring a diverse lineup.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Boomtown is in full swing down in Hampshire! Who's soaking up the unique atmosphere and incredible music this week?

angles.name: South Coast Focus
angles.copy: Hampshire is buzzing! Boomtown Festival is happening now, bringing its incredible mix of music and art to the South Coast. Hope you're having a blast!

moments.title: Happy 77th to Mark Knopfler
moments.blurb: Today, August 12, marks the 77th birthday of legendary Dire Straits frontman and guitarist Mark Knopfler, born in Glasgow in 1949.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the iconic Mark Knopfler! The Dire Straits frontman, with his unmistakable guitar style, was born today in 1949.

angles.name: Scottish Icon
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to Glasgow's own guitar hero, Mark Knopfler! The Dire Straits legend was born today in 1949. What's your favourite Dire Straits track?

moments.title: Madonna Turns 68
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday this Sunday, August 16, born in Bay City, Michigan in 1958.

angles.name: Pop Royalty
angles.copy: Still ruling the world! This Sunday, the one and only Madonna turns 68. What's your ultimate Queen of Pop anthem?

angles.name: Iconic Career
angles.copy: Happy birthday for Sunday to the incomparable Madonna, turning 68! From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', she's defined generations of pop. What's her best era?

moments.title: Summer Holiday Season Continues
moments.blurb: UK schools remain in their summer holiday period, with most returning in late August or early September, while some Scottish schools are already starting to go back this month.

angles.name: General Holiday Mood
angles.copy: Still enjoying those summer holiday vibes? Whether you're staycationing or away, make the most of the sunshine!

angles.name: Back to School Prep
angles.copy: For many, the summer holidays are still in full swing! But for some, the 'back to school' countdown has begun. Are you ready for September?

moments.title: MC Eric Turns 58
moments.blurb: This Monday, August 18, marks the 58th birthday of MC Eric (Eric Martin), the Welsh rapper best known for his work with Technotronic, born in Cardiff in 1968.

angles.name: Dance Anthem Creator
angles.copy: Happy 58th birthday for Monday to MC Eric, the voice behind Technotronic's massive hits! 'Pump Up the Jam' is still an absolute banger.

angles.name: Welsh Music Legend
angles.copy: Shout out to Cardiff's own MC Eric, turning 58 this Monday! Remember his iconic vocals with Technotronic? A true Welsh dance music pioneer.

moments.title: Sir Mix-A-Lot is 63 Today
moments.blurb: American rapper and producer Sir Mix-A-Lot, famous for 'Baby Got Back', celebrates his 63rd birthday today, August 12, born in 1963.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: Oh my God, Becky, look at his birthday! Happy 63rd to the legendary Sir Mix-A-Lot, born today in 1963. 'Baby Got Back' is still a party starter!

angles.name: 90s Throwback
angles.copy: Still got that 90s flow! Happy 63rd birthday to Sir Mix-A-Lot. What's your favourite lyric from his classic tracks?

moments.title: Feargal Sharkey Turns 67
moments.blurb: Tomorrow, August 13, marks the 67th birthday of Feargal Sharkey, the distinctive lead singer of The Undertones and a successful solo artist, born in 1959.

angles.name: Punk Icon
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday for tomorrow to the unique voice of Feargal Sharkey! From The Undertones' 'Teenage Kicks' to his solo hits, he's unforgettable.

angles.name: Undertones Tribute
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Feargal Sharkey turns 67! The legendary frontman of The Undertones brought us some of the greatest punk-pop anthems. What's your favourite?

moments.title: Country Calling UK Festival
moments.blurb: The Country Calling UK festival takes place this weekend in Chelmsford, Essex, from August 14-16.

angles.name: Country Music Weekend
angles.copy: Yee-haw! Country Calling UK is happening this weekend in Chelmsford. Who's heading down for some good ol' country music fun?

angles.name: Essex Festival
angles.copy: Essex is going country this weekend! The Country Calling UK festival kicks off Friday in Chelmsford. Get your cowboy boots ready!
